text:
alex: alerting — apiserver p99 and controller-manager workqueue spiked in eu-west1 at ~03:21 UTC, GPU node attaches timing out
maria: any etcd leader churn or storage alerts?
jordan: etcd shows two quick leader flips within 40s and raft proposal latencies rose. NVMe iops looked fine but IO wait spiked for short windows during compaction
sam: NAT metrics show ephemeral port exhaustion in eu-west1, high SYN_RECV counts on regional NATs. Likely node attach/image-pull surge from autoscaler
lee: controller-manager retries against apiserver so queue grows. Short fix: reduce concurrent-syncs to 4 in kcm and lower apiserver --max-requests-inflight for write paths
ops-bot: Incident created: apiserver-controller-queue-eu-west1. Oncall paged
alex: implementing kcm canary now. Also suggest adding a soft rate limit on provisioner node-attach per-region to prevent thundering
maria: agree. Long-term: split NAT IP pools by AZ and use registry mirrors for heavy GPU images
jordan: medium-term: stagger compaction jobs and add IO headroom for etcd nodes to avoid election triggers from short stalls
sam: actions: lee -> kcm canary (10m); alex -> provisioner rate limit config (EOD); jordan -> NAT ip expansion ticket (1h); maria -> RFC for egress-routing/fallback (2d)
ops-bot: mitigations applied, monitoring in watch window. alex: seeing p95 drop ~30%, queue length falling. Will monitor 60m :thumbsup:
